resources.string: Choose the PlayStation to play on.
Pair your PlayStation to play it here.
The new name is only used in DELOS on this device. Leave it empty for the console\'s own name (%1$s).
DELOS looks for PlayStation consoles on your home network.
Choose the console to pair. Your PCs stay separate.
No console answered. Turn on Remote Play on the PS5: Settings › System › Remote Play.
Rest mode · turn it on to pair
Sony\u2019s own page opens inside DELOS. Your password goes only to Sony; DELOS keeps your account ID to link the console.
Enter the PIN from your PS5
On the PS5: Settings › System › Remote Play › Pair Device. Enter the 8 digits shown on the TV.
Use the D-pad and A, or type the digits. The eighth digit pairs.
It is on your start screen in PlayStation mode.
How every PlayStation stream looks, sounds and connects.
These settings apply to every PlayStation stream. Your PC settings stay as they are.
Asks the console for a complete new frame whenever a frame is lost. The picture recovers faster, at the cost of a short burst of data.
Presses the Create button on the console: screenshots and clips.
Stops streaming and returns to DELOS. The game keeps running on the console.
Puts the console in rest mode and stops streaming. The game stays suspended where the console can resume it.
The console picks the bitrate itself and lowers it when the network drops packets, then raises it again. Off: the fixed bitrate below is held.
Lets the fixed bitrate go up to 200 Mbit/s. A PS5 is reported to send about 50 Mbit/s at most, so more may not change the picture. Off: the fixed bitrate stays at 50 Mbit/s or less.
Green: what this resolution is sure to get. Orange: up to the most the console is reported to send at this resolution. Red: above it; the console may not deliver it.
How many frames may wait for the decoder. Fewer means lower latency; more smooths out an uneven network.
How much sound DELOS holds back before playing it. Low has the least delay; high rides out dropouts on a weak network.
Plays the left channel on the right and the right on the left.

resources.string: Sends the device microphone to the console for voice chat. Asks for microphone access the first time; mute it in the stream menu.
Ignore loss the picture never shows
Automatic bitrate lowers the bitrate only for loss error correction could not repair, so a few lost packets on Wi-Fi do not cost picture quality.
Turning the device moves the right stick, for aiming in any game. While L2: only while L2 is held.
How far the right stick moves when you turn the device left or right. The stream menu changes the same value.
How far the right stick moves when you tilt the device up or down. The stream menu changes the same value.
Sideways gyro aiming sensitivity. Applies at once and is kept.
Up and down gyro aiming sensitivity. Applies at once and is kept.

Fingers on the screen act as the DualSense touchpad, for swipes and touches. Off: the screen ignores touches.
A DualSense connected by USB plays the console’s haptics through its actuators and adaptive triggers. Android asks once for USB permission. Off: Android handles it with simple rumble.
